name: Round 13
change: Round 13's Parallax, which Mike liked. The pools shift with where the pointer is, the deeper ones away from it and the nearer ones toward it; the deepest travel about a quarter of a panel from edge to edge, so on small panels the shift is slight.
good: The version Mike liked: on the large window the pools slide clearly as the pointer crosses it.
watch: On small panels the shift is a fraction of the large window's, so it barely shows.

name: Small panels too
change: Round 13's Parallax, but on a panel smaller than the large window the pools shift as far at its edges as on the large window, so small panels show it too: the deepest pools travel about a quarter of the large window from edge to edge.
good: Round 13's strength on the large window, and small panels now shift as far at their edges, so every panel shows it.
watch: On a small panel the light moves further for the same movement of the pointer, so it can feel livelier there.

change: Small panels too, half as strong again: the deepest pools travel about a third of the large window from edge to edge.
good: Easier to see everywhere while still calm: the deepest pools travel about a third of the large window.
watch: A small step up; the difference from Small panels too shows most on the large window.

change: Small panels too, twice as strong: the deepest pools travel about half the large window from edge to edge.
good: Clearly visible: the deepest pools travel about half the large window, so the slab looks deep.
watch: On small panels, pools slide out of view and others come in, so the light changes more than it shifts.

change: Small panels too, three times as strong: the deepest pools travel nearly three-quarters of the large window from edge to edge.
good: Unmistakable: the light swims through the slab as the pointer crosses it.
watch: Can feel busy and draw the eye from the text; on small panels the light is different at each edge.
